title: spicerack.diagnostics/1
description: What became of one deck, written or run: how far it got, its status, its diagnostics located in its source, and the simulator's failure.

spicerack.description: The version of spicerack that wrote the file.

variant.description: The deck's id: the stem of this file and of the files it names.

stage.description: How far the deck got: netlist (written, or not, for a dialect), route (a run that picked no simulator), run.

dialect.description: The language the deck is written in; null when a run picked no simulator and its refusal is about none.

status.description: written (netlist) or ok (run); refused: nothing was run; failed: something that ran failed.

source.description: The file, beside this one, of the deck's source: the text the diagnostics' lines count in. null: the deck has none.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic of the deck, the notes of a written one among them, in the writer's order.

message.description: The line SpiceRack prints for it.

file.description: source, when the diagnostic is at a statement.

line.description: Its line in the source, from 1.

column.description: Its column in that line, from 1.

statement.description: The text of the statement it is at.

element.description: The element's name, when the statement is one.

simulator.description: null unless the stage is route or the status failed.

backend.description: The simulator picked, or the one a routing refusal is about.

exit_status.description: Of a simulator that exited nonzero.

log.description: The file, beside this one, of everything that simulator printed.

message.description: The failure in one line; null for a refusal.

missing.description: What a routing refusal (W0180 to W0182) found missing.
